tools.name: get_website_audit_offer
tools.description: Describe Pasportoo's paid audit of a public website (bugs that break sales, passive security checks, speed and UX issues; evidence and a fix for each), with price, delivery time, limits and how the owner orders it. Read-only; nothing is ordered.

tools.name: prepare_website_audit_order
tools.description: Validate a public https website address and return a prefilled order link for its owner. Use it when the user wants their own website checked for bugs, security problems or UX issues. Does not order, charge or contact the site; the owner confirms authorisation and pays on the linked page.

tools.name: list_pasportoo_agents
tools.description: List Pasportoo's specialist agents (website audit, accessibility, speed and SEO, code security, authorised pentest) with whether each can be ordered now and what has been measured.
